must_find.summary: Adds a --json flag to the existing `report` subparser in tally/cli.py (build_parser) and branches in cmd_report; no new command, module tree or entry point.

Produces the JSON with the existing tally/serialize.py (to_json / to_data) on the existing Report dataclass from reports.by_project, the same path `export` already uses, instead of hand-building dicts or adding a new serializer.
Keeps the current text table (render.report_table) as the default output when --json is not given; existing behavior unchanged.
Adds a test in tests/test_cli.py that runs `report --json` via main(argv), parses stdout with json.loads, and checks fields (e.g. rows, total_hours).

nice_to_find.summary: Notes that with --json nothing else (no banner/status text) may be printed to stdout, so the output stays valid for jq; empty period prints valid JSON (e.g. rows: []) rather than 'No entries in this period.'
States the JSON shape matches the `report` object written by `export` (since, until, rows[project, hours, entries, share], total_hours) so consumers see one schema.

must_not_flag.summary: Proposes a new output-formatter plugin architecture or abstraction layer: a Formatter base class/protocol, a registry, multiple formatter classes, or a generic --format option framework beyond what was asked.
Plan is heavyweight for the request: multiple options tables compared at length, rollout/feature flags, observability or migration sections with content, or more than ~5 implementation steps.
Adds a third-party dependency (e.g. click, rich, orjson, pydantic), against the stdlib-only rule in AGENTS.md.
